page.layout: One printed page, title page. Full width: title lines at top, centred; an engraving in the middle; imprint lines below the engraving, centred. No margin text, no running head, no page number.

main_text.l: Apud Bartholomęum à Bilt, ad inter signe pegasi. Anno clo. Io. cxix.

page.notes: Engraving between the title and the imprint: a woman seated in a chair with a man beside her, drawing a sword; behind them a burning town, figures and a ruined building in the landscape, and a sun or inscription at the top. Not transcribed as text. The imprint line "Anno clo. Io. cxix." reads MDCXIX in Roman numerals (the reversed-C forms are printed as cIↄ / Io). The sign on the imprint is printed as "ad inter signe", with "inter" and "signe" as printed; "pegasi" is printed with a long-s form, transcribed as "pegasi". Some lower-case letters in the imprint are slightly blurred; "Bartholomęum" and "Bilt" are read with confidence but may be uncertain.
